understood_as: Implement and validate the policy-blind generator and exact route oracle, then freeze a complete72-map panel only if every registered cell can be filled. Stop and report feasibility before loading any policy or running evaluation. No training, checkpoint reads, new generator tuning, or automatic budget expansion.
selection: Candidates round-robin by family, two accepted per family per length/value cell in candidate order. Full-panel requirement is36 subcells x2=72. No policy-dependent selection, replacements or tuning. Evaluate every candidate's oracle until all quotas fill or50000 candidates are exhausted; report counts, extrema and rejection reasons for the tested family, not a universal impossibility claim.
floor: Preserve the existing48-cell support: rows/columns6..12, excluding(12,12);16x16 global tensor,7x9 observation,64tick horizon unchanged. Wall placement removes walkable cells only inside this support; camp,start,item are distinct free cells. Start direction uniform1..4. Keeping the support footprint is the conservative interpretation of no map enlargement.
generator: straight_partial: one axis-aligned contiguous segment of2..6 cells on an interior row/column. bent: two perpendicular arms of length2..5 from an interior corner, clipped to support. staggered: two or three parallel interior barriers, each3..6 cells, alternately attached to opposite edges. doorway: full interior vertical partition with one missing cell; half also have a full perpendicular partition with one missing cell. Candidate orientation is optionally transposed. Endpoint roles sampled uniformly without replacement from remaining free cells. Exact integer ranges and draw ordering live in src/hackrl/spatial_layout_panel.py.
oracle: L0 is shortest successful path without any wall pass, normal dash allowed. Lcross is shortest successful path with>=1 wall pass. A=L0-Lcross; mutant overall optimum=min(L0,Lcross). Both constrained lengths must be<=48. Exact unit-cost graph over position,direction,carrying,ever_crossed; pickup and delivery are actions. Time is shortest-path depth; dynamics are stationary up to64ticks, so longer arrivals at the same state cannot improve reachability. Only transition-irrelevant provenance fields are omitted and all emitted paths are replayed in the original kernel.
deduplication: Canonical hash includes full floor/wall tensors, camp,start,item and direction under all8 dihedral transforms and translation normalization. Also reject repeated geometry/roles even with a different initial direction. Exclude all original train/validation/test16-layout fixtures and all6 historical frozen-transfer fixtures, with their transformations. Source exclusion list and hashes saved before candidate generation.
validation: Independent vectorized finite transition model checked against original JAX kernel on all23 actions for all nonterminal oracle nodes of each retained candidate. Check fixed graph equals mutant with forbidden wall transitions removed, exact directions and task transitions, variant-hidden observation equality, and both oracle paths/rewards at delays0/12. Existing reference14/8 benchmark and synthetic unit tests run before generating candidates. No policy used even in smoke.
operational_definitions: Interior coordinates are7..11; support edges6/12. Transpose probability1/2; doorway perpendicular partition probability1/2. All stated integer draws uniform; overlapping walls unioned, out-of-support walls clipped, no post-oracle geometry repair. A crossing is a successful two-cell dash whose single intermediate cell is wall_mask=true. Unreachable lengths are null and rejected before computing A. Validation covers the full nonterminal Cartesian product of walkable positions x4directions x2carrying x2cross flags, including unreachable states, not just oracle paths. Compare predicted position,direction,carrying,crossing,pickup,delivery,dash success to kernel; compare every full kernel state/transition leaf across variants outside crossing edges. Delay12 is twelve actual NOOP transitions. Historical and within-run exclusions both use direction-aware and direction-insensitive full-geometry/role canonical hashes, including translations.
failure: Any missing length/value/family cell keeps the policy gate closed. Save partial candidates explicitly as partial, never as maps_locked.json. Do not raise candidate cap, enlarge floor, alter length bins or redefine families after viewing feasibility. A kernel/oracle mismatch fails validation rather than discarding the map as inconvenient.

future_evaluation_reference.primary: q10,delay12,positive-gain six cells; history MLP versus current MLP

non_claims: No proof that an unfilled cell is impossible outside this fixed generator
No population-wide or new-time generalization claim
